bugs.title: Standalone Restock estimates purchase cost using the product selling price
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company.
Open Products and inspect QA-ADD-mv9rtxw1-3b087e: cost price Rs40 and selling price Rs100.
Open Store Inventory for QA Inspection Store 20261017, then click Restock.
Deselect all items and search the exact QA SKU.
Select only that item and set quantity to 1.
Read its Cost amount and Estimated restock cost; cancel without confirming.
bugs.expected: For quantity1, line cost and estimated restocking cost use the product's purchase/cost price, Rs40, rather than its selling price.
bugs.actual: The line Cost and estimated total both show100 for one item, matching its selling price100 instead of its stored cost40. The same result reproduces in the independent check and integrated flow.
bugs.comment: Calculate estimates from the applicable unit purchase/cost value and format them with the company currency. Preserve the independently passing stock-quantity behavior. This ticket concerns the visible estimate; no incorrect ledger or stock valuation is claimed. The read-only reproduction never confirms a restock.

bugs.title: No standalone supplier GRN can be created without a Purchase Order
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company.
Open Purchasing > Purchase Orders and look for a way to receive a shipment without creating or selecting a Purchase Order.
Open Suppliers and inspect the available receiving actions.
Open Store Inventory and select Restock.
Try to record a separate Goods Receipt Note by selecting a supplier, product and received quantity, leaving all other details blank.
bugs.expected: A separate GRN can be created without a Purchase Order. Supplier, product and quantity are the only mandatory user inputs; delivery-note/reference number, dates, notes and all other details are optional. Saving retains the supplier receipt and posts the received inventory.
bugs.actual: The inspected Purchasing, Suppliers and Inventory screens expose no standalone GRN entry. The available Restock dialog selects products and quantities but has no supplier input or supplier-receipt form. The required minimum-input GRN cannot be created through this UI.
bugs.comment: Add a separate GRN flow with supplier selection and product/quantity lines, persistence and stock posting. Allow all other user-entered details to remain blank/defaulted; do not require a Purchase Order. This is one missing-workflow ticket. Required-field, optional-field, saved-receipt and stock-posting assertions are unverified until the form becomes available. No claim is made that an unpublished backend endpoint is absent.
